brief.goal: Remove the duplicate right-pane Case Gate card while preserving the single backend Gate truth, left conversation status, workflow nodes and bottom progress refresh.

allowed_writes: Task, Context Manifest and project control-plane status
frontend presentation files and the directly related smoke test
forbidden_actions: all external platform calls and writes
all workbench runtime commands, confirmation consumption and runtime Job creation
database, schema, workflow_case_summary, backend API or Gate policy changes
removal of the bottom progress and refresh controls
persistence of raw or sensitive data
validation_plan: desktop and narrow viewport readonly browser verification
stop_conditions: the change requires a backend, API, database or Gate semantic modification
left conversation status, confirmation cards or bottom progress refresh regress
a validation path would submit a workbench command or create a runtime Job
